headline: In Kazakhstan, the heads of Samruk-Kazyna JSC and Kazakhstan Temir Zholy NC have been arrested
summary: The chairmen of state holding Samruk-Kazyna, Nurlan Zhakupov, and national railway company Kazakhstan Temir Zholy, Yelzhas Otyshiyev, were arrested on suspicion of corruption.
why: Samruk-Kazyna is Kazakhstan's sovereign wealth fund, holding stakes in state companies including the national railway operator. Leadership arrests at these firms can affect governance and investor confidence in state-linked assets.
original_headline: В Казахстане арестованы главы АО «Самрук-Казына» и «НК «Казахстан темир жолы»
